arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && cat > memtest.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Process 8 full-size instances in one process; watch memory growth."""
import json, resource, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import analyze, genbig

worst = 0.0
for seed, style in [(0, 'wide'), (1, 'tight'), (2, 'narrow'), (3, 'wide'),
                   (4, 'tight'), (5, 'narrow'), (6, 'wide'), (7, 'tight')]:
    x = genbig.gen(seed, style)
    t0 = time.process_time()
    r = analyze.process_line(json.dumps(x, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
    dt = time.process_time() - t0
    worst = max(worst, dt)
    rss = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / 1024.0
    print('  %s seed=%d: %.2fs, peak RSS %.0f MiB' % (style, seed, dt, rss))
print('8 full-size instances in one process: worst %.2fs, peak RSS %.0f MiB'
      % (worst, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / 1024.0))
PYEOF
timeout 175 python3 memtest.py
